transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I am so very sorry! It completely slipped my mind. The Master's message must be prioritized — I'll take it to the crows myself. Please, allow me to rectify this immediately.
